FLASHCARD SET · AGES 3–4 MONTHS

Colors & First Objects Flashcards

Twelve cards for the Infant 1 stage: three strong colours, everyday objects your baby already sees every day, and a gentle first teddy bear.

These cards belong to Infant 1 on the Kiddo School learning path.

THE CARDS

Every card in the set.

Each card has its own page: the picture and short, practical notes for grown-ups — what it is for, how to use it, how to print it. Tap any card to open it.

HOW TO USE THESE CARDS

Four ways that work.

You do not need a plan or a printer schedule. Pick one idea, try it for two minutes and see what happens.

  1. 01

    One colour at a time

    Show the red circle today, the yellow circle tomorrow. Babies learn colours by repetition, not by sorting through all three at once.

  2. 02

    Pair card with real thing

    Show the cup card, then a real cup. The jump from picture to world is the lesson — and it takes ten seconds.

  3. 03

    Let them reach

    Around this age babies reach for what interests them. Hold the card within gentle swiping distance and celebrate every bat.

  4. 04

    Say it, pause, wait

    Name the card clearly, then stay quiet for a moment. Whatever comes back — a coo, a kick, a stare — is your baby’s turn.
